description:
## Goal

Give hidden macro roots the same persistent product ownership as user roots. Macro execution reads the retained RootBackendContent of its RootBackendProduct directly. Delete both the BackendProgram scheduler bridge and the redundant MacroExecutable job/fact/map.

## Researched ownership model

RootBackendProductAnswer is a cheap Clone pair of independently shared BackendProgram and MaterializedTransportPlan values. ProductValue owns this pair directly: the redundant outer Rc is deleted. Their lifetimes differ: transport-only movement can change the root answer while equal backend content preserves its allocation and generation. ProductMemo settlement retains equal backend handles by replacing the candidate pair field, without requiring unique Rc ownership or cloning payloads.

Scheduler source consumers need exact product dependencies. Replacing backend_revision with a generation field in MacroExecutable would preserve a second movement protocol. Instead, DependencyKey distinguishes World facts from root-owned products. The existing scheduler owns all read/wait/finality propagation; product states and generations come directly from retained ProductMemo through an external dependency state provider, without product FactTable slots or synthetic publishers.

## Atomic strategy

1. Prove external product dependency behavior in the existing generic scheduler: dirty content prevents stale downstream consumption; equal reproduction restores readiness without executing a Current reader; changed generation wakes only exact readers.
2. Keep active and inactive root sessions reachable through one retained ownership model with checked lexical borrows, including nested macro roots. Product drives release mutable session borrows before running scheduler jobs.
3. Source expansion records typed product reads/waits and executes the memo-owned backend handle. Named product waits drive the same ordinary retained product loop. Delete BuildMacroExecutable, MacroExecutable fact/map, and their execution indirection.
4. Delete BuildBackendProduct, BackendProgram fact/map/World projection, product-to-fact copying, synthetic completion identities, backend/native revision remnants, and bridge-only tests/docs.
5. Canonicalize equal backend programs in ProductMemo settlement. Collapse outer root-answer Rc into an immutable pair of independently shared program/transport values; no unique-ownership assertion or deep copy.
6. Preserve native exact content identity, native failure/session restore/retry, root retirement, exact causality, and all semantic/runtime/artifact results.

## Acceptance

Macro and user roots use one retained product model. No backend or macro artifact payload remains in World, no readiness mirror or synthetic product job exists, and no parallel dependency scheduler is introduced.

Unchanged macro requests reuse the same allocation/session/generation with no product evaluation or backend work. Unrelated edits invalidate no requested-root product. Reached macro-source changes recompute only exact readers. Program-equal and transport-only movement preserve backend allocation/generation and do not execute source consumers. Cross-root nested macro expansion and recursion retain exact readiness/finality; missing/invalid macro diagnostics stay correct. Retirement removes exact subscriptions and releases memo-owned artifacts.

Cold ticket-scoped adversarial review, full macro/library/serial-matrix coverage, causal work and canonical artifact/runtime proofs, formatting, check, strict clippy, and current documentation pass. Temporary probes and construction scaffolding leave in the same cutover.

## Exact readiness and failure boundaries

Product request failure is DriveOutcome::DependencyFailed with the real typed dependency, never a synthetic Job. Failed observed requests remain in the exact unresolved request index and are queued for the next drive, so failure cannot make their source consumers appear final. Product quiescence reads authoritative retained states. Before certifying a candidate fact, the ordinary scheduler follows only that candidate's unquiet publisher/read edges to reject still-unsettled external ground; unrelated internal cycles remain ordinarily quiescent. This scoped guard is skipped in O(1) when the external provider has no outstanding requests. Retiring an observed product publishes its exact withdrawal through the scheduler and releases its payload and fact subscriptions. Outstanding source-consumer demand survives even if the product never produced and withdrawal moves no value/readiness. The next exact request lazily recreates memo observation; retirement allocates no replacement memo. Product requests reuse the same deduplicated FIFO Agenda as scheduler jobs, while the requested-address set represents unsettled demand including active validation. Settled/unsubscribe cancellation and later renewed demand cannot create duplicate validation.
title: Delete the BackendProgram scheduler bridge after macro roots join persistent products
